name: gentifi
description: Ask independent local shops what they have, check prices and opening times, and prepare reservations you confirm yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Ask local independent shops what they have
interface.longDescription: Gentifi connects you to independent local shops, cafés and makers, starting in Bristol and South Gloucestershire. Ask what a shop has, check prices, stock and opening times, and prepare a reservation or order. Nothing is ordered for you: you see a summary and confirm it with the shop yourself, by email or on the shop's own checkout. Information comes from each shop's own catalogue, which the shop keeps up to date.
defaultPrompt: Does Hollow Lane Farm Shop have free-range eggs?
When is Hollow Lane Farm Shop open?
Which shops on Gentifi sell sourdough?

positive.description: Find a shop by what it sells
positive.prompt: Which shops on Gentifi have eggs?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Hollow Lane Farm Shop (a fictional demo shop) and its free-range eggs (dozen).

positive.description: Check a product at a named shop
positive.prompt: Does Hollow Lane Farm Shop have free-range eggs?
positive.expected_behavior: Says yes: free-range eggs, £3.20 per box of a dozen, in stock, and when the prices were last updated.

positive.prompt: When is Hollow Lane Farm Shop open?
Could I get 3 sourdough loaves from Hollow Lane Farm Shop?
positive.expected_behavior: Says 3 sourdough loaves are available at £4.50 each.

positive.description: Prepare a reservation for the customer to confirm
positive.prompt: Reserve a dozen eggs at Hollow Lane Farm Shop for Saturday.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a summary (1 x free-range eggs, total £3.20, Saturday) and an email link the customer can choose to send to the shop. Says nothing has been ordered or sent.

negative.prompt: Pay Hollow Lane Farm Shop for my eggs with my card.
Find me a plumber in Manchester on Gentifi.

negative.description: Changing a shop's data is not supported
negative.prompt: Change the price of eggs at Hollow Lane Farm Shop to £1.

review.commerce_description: Helps customers reserve or order physical goods from independent shops. Gentifi takes no payments: prepare_order returns a summary, and the customer confirms with the shop themselves by email or on the shop's own checkout website.

publication.release_notes: First release: find independent shops on Gentifi, check their products, prices, stock and opening times, and prepare reservations the customer confirms.
